slides.title: Spoken Tutorial on The 3 C’s of Effective Prompts
slides.narration: Welcome to this **Spoken Tutorial** on **The 3 C’s of Effective Prompts**.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to,
• Define **Clarity**, **Context**, and **Constraints** for effective **prompting**.
• Explain the importance of each C in guiding **AI** responses.
• Apply the 3 C's to improve **prompt** examples.
• Compare **prompt** examples to understand the impact of the 3 C's.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration: Here I am using a browser on a computer or mobile.

slides.title: Pre-requisites
slides.narration: To follow this tutorial, you should know the **fundamentals of prompting**.

slides.title: Clarity: Be Specific
slides.narration:
Let's start with **Clarity**.
What does it mean to be clear in a **prompt**?
It means being specific and precise.
Think of it like giving directions to a new place.
If you say, 'Go somewhere near the market,' it is vague.
The person will get confused.
But if you say, 'Go straight for 200 meters.'
Then, 'Turn left at the big banyan tree.'
These directions are clear.
Similarly, clear **prompts** remove all ambiguity for the **AI**.
This helps the **AI** understand exactly what you want.
It reduces the chances of getting an irrelevant or unexpected response.
slides.image_prompt: Section Header: Clarity. Illustration showing clear road signs vs vague directions.

slides.title: Context: Set the Scene
slides.narration:
Next, we have **Context**.
**Context** means providing background information.
It sets the scene for the **AI**.
Imagine writing a script for a play.
You would tell the actors about the setting, the characters, and the mood.
This helps them perform their roles correctly.
Similarly, giving **context** to an **AI** guides its tone, purpose, and audience.
For example, tell the **AI** if it needs to write for children or for experts.
This ensures the **AI** generates a response suitable for your needs.
slides.image_prompt: Section Header: Context. Illustration showing a stage director guiding actors with a script.

slides.title: Constraints: Define Boundaries
slides.narration:
Finally, let's talk about **Constraints**.
**Constraints** are like boundaries or rules.
They tell the **AI** what limits to follow.
Think of a mold used for baking a cake.
The mold defines the cake's shape and size.
Similarly, **constraints** define the output's length, format, and style.
You can tell the **AI** to write only 100 words.
Or, you can ask for the output in a bulleted list.
Using **constraints** helps you get the exact structure you need from the **AI**.
slides.image_prompt: Section Header: Constraints. Illustration showing a cake mold shaping batter.

slides.title: Demo: Starting with a Vague Prompt
slides.narration:
Now, let's see these 3 C's in action.
We will start with a vague **prompt**.
Suppose you ask an **AI** to 'Write about the benefits of exercise.'
This **prompt** lacks **Clarity**, **Context**, and **Constraints**.
The **AI** might give a very general or long response.
It may not be useful for your specific purpose.
Notice the output here.
It is generic and does not focus on any particular aspect.
This shows why vague **prompts** often lead to undesirable results.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing 'Write about the benefits of exercise...'. AI generating a generic response on screen.

slides.title: Demo: Enhancing with Clarity, Context, and Constraints
slides.narration:
With that in mind, let's improve our previous **prompt**.
We will apply the 3 C's: **Clarity**, **Context**, and **Constraints**.
Let's refine the **prompt** to, 'Write a 150-word social media post.
It should highlight the mental health benefits of daily walking.
This is specifically for busy professionals.
Use a motivational and encouraging tone.'
See the difference in the output now.
The **AI** provides a focused, concise, and appropriate response.
It is perfect for a social media post.
This demonstrates the power of effective **prompting**.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing 'Write a 150-word social media post...'. AI generating a focused response on screen.

slides.title: Demo: The Impact of Effective Prompting
slides.narration:
Let's visually compare the two outputs.
On one side, we have the vague **prompt**'s output.
On the other, we see the improved **prompt**'s output.
Observe how the 3 C's transformed a generic response.
It became a targeted and useful piece of content.
This comparison clearly shows the impact.
Applying **Clarity**, **Context**, and **Constraints** helps you get better results.
It helps you get exactly what you need from **AI** tools.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side: vague prompt output vs improved prompt output

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we learned.
We discussed the **3 C's of Effective Prompts**.
**Clarity** helps in reducing ambiguity.
**Context** guides the **AI**'s tone and purpose.
**Constraints** define the output's length and format.
By using these 3 C's, you can create much better **prompts**.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Now as an assignment,
Take a vague **prompt** you have used before.
Rewrite it by applying **Clarity**, **Context**, and **Constraints**.
Generate a response from an **AI** tool using both **prompts**.
Compare the results.
